verdict.rationale: LibreChat's MCP integration explicitly lists 'web browsers' as one of the tool types it can connect to (librechat-docs-7), implying browser automation is possible via third-party MCP servers, but there is no first-party documentation of a built-in browser-driving tool with navigate/login/click/extract capabilities. missing for 10: native browser-control tool docs, hands-on example of login/click/extract via LibreChat, independent verification that MCP-based browser control actually works end-to-end.
